stem: At a doctors’ surgery, the number of missed appointments per day has a Poisson distribution. In the past the mean number of missed appointments per day has been 0.9. Following some publicity, the manager carries out a hypothesis test to determine whether this mean has decreased. If there are fewer than 3 missed appointments in a randomly chosen 5-day period, she will conclude that the mean has decreased.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the probability of a Type I error.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: State what is meant by a Type I error in this context.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Find the probability of a Type II error if the mean number of missed appointments per day is 0.2.
